attribute-definition.description: Turn the Gameball Integration on or off. Also requires the "gameball.http.api.cred" Service Credential (Administration > Operations > Services > Service Credentials) to be filled in with a valid API Key (User ID) and Secret Key (Password).

attribute-definition.display-name: Exclude Gift Certificate Tender from Gameball totalPaid
attribute-definition.description: When enabled (the default), the portion of an order paid for with a Gift Certificate is subtracted from the totalPaid amount reported to Gameball, so points are not awarded on gift-certificate-funded spend.

Writes one INFO line to the custom Gameball log for every customer upsert the storefront sends or deliberately skips. This is the only way an operator can confirm that exactly one Gameball customer upsert is sent per registration and per profile save - count the "upsert sent" lines sharing one sfccRequestId. Turning it off silences the success lines, the skip lines AND the transient-failure warnings (rate limit, service timeout, Gameball-side 5xx), which means a Gameball outage stops appearing in the log at all; only permanent errors are written regardless of this setting. Leave it on unless log volume forces otherwise.

Writes DEBUG lines for the high-volume, uninteresting Gameball skip paths - chiefly "integration disabled", which would otherwise fire on every profile save on a site where Gameball is switched off. Off by default; switch it on only while diagnosing why an expected sync did not happen.

Outcome of syncing this order to Gameball: TRACKED (successfully sent), SKIPPED (excluded by a gating rule - integration off, guest order, replacement order, or cancelled/failed status), or FAILED (the API call errored or returned a non-ok result).
The exact orderId value sent to Gameball's integrations/orders endpoint. Only set when gbTrackState is TRACKED. Needed so a future refund feature can replay this same id.
The exact customerId value sent to Gameball for this order. Only set when gbTrackState is TRACKED. Kept for auditability.

The error/result message from the most recent failed Gameball sync attempt on this order. Only set when gbTrackState is FAILED. Surfaced here for support visibility since there is no Gameball dashboard in this iteration.
